Major AI Developments.summary: Generative AI is being used by 95% of developers in Southeast Asia on a weekly basis, leading to higher engagement and productivity gains of up to 70%. This increased productivity is allowing for more time to be spent on upskilling, mentoring, and complex work. The adoption of GenAI is also improving global collaboration and helping to address talent shortages in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: NCP uses AI-generated voice, video of Ajit Pawar to make emotional pitch in zilla parishad polls; kicks off debate
Major AI Developments.summary: The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) is using AI-generated voice and video clips of Ajit Pawar to make emotional appeals in zilla parishad polls. The clips mimic Pawar's voice and image, aiming to connect with voters by recalling his vision and endorsing trusted candidates. This tactic has sparked a debate over the ethical boundaries of using AI in political campaigning.

Major AI Developments.title: India Inc On The Move 2026: Leaders Decode the Next Phase of AI-Driven Manufacturing
Major AI Developments.summary: India Inc On The Move 2026 will take place in Mumbai on February 12, 2026, bringing together manufacturing leaders, technology innovators, and policy influencers. The event will focus on the future of Indian manufacturing, highlighting strategies and innovations in AI-driven manufacturing. The theme of the event is "The Future is Here: Smart, AI-Powered, Sustainable Manufacturing".

Major AI Developments.title: How Bharat Intelligence uses AI to solve farm labour crisis in Maharashtra’s villages
Major AI Developments.summary: Bharat Intelligence, a Mumbai-based agritech startup, is using AI to address the farm labour crisis in Maharashtra's villages. The company has developed a digital model of villages across the state, which its AI engine uses to deploy labourers to farmers with accuracy. This innovative approach aims to streamline the labour allocation process and support local farmers.

Major AI Developments.title: Persistent Extends Growth Run to 23 Quarters, Profit Slips 7% QoQ
Major AI Developments.summary: Persistent has extended its growth run to 23 quarters, with order bookings reaching $674.5 million in total contract value and $501.9 million in annual contract value. Despite this growth, the company's profit slipped 7% quarter-over-quarter. The company's consistent growth streak is a notable achievement in the industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Raana Semiconductors Raises $3 Mn Seed Funding for Silicon Ingot Systems
Major AI Developments.summary: Raana Semiconductors has raised $3 million in seed funding to develop silicon ingot systems. The company aims to reduce reliance on imported silicon ingots and wafers by enabling local manufacturing. This investment will support Raana Semiconductors' efforts to establish a domestic silicon production capability.

Major AI Developments.title: FireAI raises early-stage funding from IPV, VCats, and SucSEED Indovation
Major AI Developments.summary: FireAI, an AI analytics platform, has raised Rs 6.2 crore ($800K) in pre-seed and seed funding from investors including Inflection Point Ventures, Venture Catalyst, and SucSEED Indovation Fund. The startup has also launched a mobile decision intelligence app, with plans to use the funding to enhance its capabilities and scale infrastructure. The investment will further support the company's expansion and acceleration of enterprise adoption.

AI Start-Up News.title: Data Science Wizards raises $5 Mn in pre-Series A round
AI Start-Up News.summary: Data Science Wizards, a Mumbai-based enterprise tech company, has raised $5 million in a pre-Series A funding round from angel investors. The company had previously secured $1.4 million in seed funding in October 2024, valuing it at $16.4 million. The new funding will be used to drive product innovation, expand operations, and strengthen its teams.

AI Start-Up News.title: Clinic and salon chain Bodycraft raises Rs 120 Cr led by Singularity AMC
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bodycraft, a beauty and wellness platform, has raised Rs 120 crore in a funding round led by Singularity AMC. This is the company's first major funding round in nearly nine years, following a Rs 18 crore raise in 2017. The fresh capital will be used to expand its presence in India, invest in technology, and enhance customer experience.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rusk Media bags Rs 100 Cr funding to expand content play
AI Start-Up News.summary: Rusk Media has secured Rs 100 Cr in funding to expand its content offerings. The company plans to use the funds to grow its Alright! TV platform, build AI-powered production tools, and expand its content franchises. This investment will also help Rusk Media pursue international audiences and further establish its presence in the market.

AI Start-Up News.title: Used two-wheeler platform Speedioo raises seed funding led by Atomic Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Speedioo, a Pune-based used two-wheeler startup, has raised Rs 10 crore in seed funding led by Atomic Capital. The funds will be used to build its AI-native technology stack, expand distribution, and strengthen partnerships. Founded by former CredR and Rentomojo executives, Speedioo aims to improve transparency and customer experience in the used two-wheeler market through AI integration.

AI Start-Up News.title: Former Icertis executives' startup Rivvun AI raises $7.55 Mn in seed funding
AI Start-Up News.summary: Rivvun AI, a startup founded by former Icertis executives, has raised $7.55 million in seed funding co-led by Sitara Capital and 3one4 Capital. The funds will be used to enhance AI capabilities, expand the workforce, and scale customer acquisition efforts. Rivvun AI's software helps enterprises identify revenue and procurement leakages, such as missed commercial obligations and supplier rebate losses.

AI Start-Up News.title: Figtree Pharmacy raises seed funding from AJVC Fund
AI Start-Up News.summary: Mumbai-based pharmacy startup Figtree Pharmacy has raised seed funding from AJVC Fund and other investors, with plans to use the funds to strengthen logistics, build its technology stack, and expand operations. The startup aims to scale its network to 25 stores, focusing on neighbourhood-focused pharmacies across Mumbai and Delhi. Figtree was founded in 2025 by Adrit Chaturvedi and Yatin Sharma, with the goal of expanding its private-label medicines and store operations.

AI Start-Up News.title: IAN Alpha Fund leads Rs 32.7 Cr round in sports-tech startup SportVot
AI Start-Up News.summary: SportVot, a sports-tech startup, has raised Rs 32.7 crore in a funding round led by IAN Alpha Fund, with participation from other investors. The Mumbai-based startup had previously secured Rs 9.4 crore in a pre-Series A round in February 2024. The new funding will be used to expand internationally and invest in AI-led production.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI will automate work. India’s next startup wave will sell experiences
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's next startup wave is expected to focus on selling experiences, as AI automates work and people seek unique human interactions. This shift is driven by the desire for authentic, unscripted experiences that cannot be replicated by technology. The value of human connection and storytelling will become a key differentiator in the market.

AI Start-Up News.title: ‘AI investor’ Lemonbuddy takes position to evaluate startup ideas
AI Start-Up News.summary: Lemonbuddy, an AI investor, has taken a position to evaluate startup ideas, utilizing its artificial intelligence capabilities to assess potential investments. This move aims to identify and support promising startups, providing them with the necessary resources to grow and succeed. Lemonbuddy's AI-driven approach is expected to streamline the evaluation process and make more informed investment decisions.

AI Start-Up News.title: DAAKit raises $138K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: DAAKit, a hyperlocal fulfillment and last-mile logistics startup, has raised $138K in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand operations, launch new dark stores, and strengthen its technology infrastructure and team. DAAKit was founded in 2024 and operates an asset-light logistics model, currently serving cities including Delhi, Gurugram, and Mumbai.

AI Start-Up News.title: MSN biggest investor in battlefield AI systems maker Tsecond.ai
AI Start-Up News.summary: MSN is the largest investor in Tsecond.ai, a company that develops battlefield AI systems. Tsecond.ai creates artificial intelligence technologies for military use, with MSN holding a significant stake in the company. The investment underscores MSN's interest in AI-powered defense technologies.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI made developers faster. So why are product teams still slow?
AI Start-Up News.summary: AI-driven coding tools have increased developer speed, but product teams remain slow due to limitations in implementing these gains at the team level. Anand Hariharan discussed this issue at DevSparks 2026, highlighting the need for context engineering and spec-driven development to bridge the gap. He proposed these approaches as solutions to fully leverage AI-driven coding benefits.

AI Start-Up News.title: Can AI help healthcare systems make sense of their data?
AI Start-Up News.summary: Gaurav Tripathi, Co-founder and Group CTO at Partex.AI, discussed how AI technologies can aid healthcare systems in analyzing medical data. Federated learning, knowledge graphs, and agentic AI are key solutions that can help institutions make sense of fragmented data. These technologies can achieve this goal without compromising patient privacy, according to Tripathi's presentation at DevSparks 2026 in Pune.

AI Start-Up News.title: Startup Infiheal bags honour at AI Impact Summit
AI Start-Up News.summary: Startup Infiheal received an honor at the AI Impact Summit, a recognition of its achievements in the field of artificial intelligence. The award acknowledges the company's innovative contributions to AI. Infiheal's win highlights its potential for growth and impact in the industry.

AI Start-Up News.title: This startup is bringing the benefits of AI to retail stock market investors
AI Start-Up News.summary: Mumbai-based startup InvestorAi has developed an AI-powered stock picking platform. The platform aims to assist retail investors in navigating the stock market. InvestorAi's technology is designed to provide benefits of AI to individual investors, helping them make informed decisions.

AI Start-Up News.title: Maharashtra poised to lead India’s public-sector AI adoption: Wadhwani AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: Maharashtra is expected to take the lead in India's public-sector adoption of artificial intelligence, according to Wadhwani AI. The state is poised to leverage AI for various public services and governance. Wadhwani AI anticipates Maharashtra to set an example for other states to follow in AI adoption.

AI Start-Up News.title: How this deeptech startup is driving seaweed cultivation along the western coast of India
AI Start-Up News.summary: ClimaCrew, a Mumbai-based deeptech startup, is promoting seaweed cultivation along India's western coast by partnering with coastal communities and industries. The company uses an AI-driven platform to analyze satellite data and identify suitable locations for seaweed cultivation. This initiative aims to harness the nutritional potential of seaweed in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

AI Start-Up News.title: Digital clinic Pinky Promise raises $1 Mn led by Rebalance Angel Community
AI Start-Up News.summary: Pinky Promise, an AI-led digital clinic for women, has raised $1 million in a pre-seed funding round led by Rebalance Angel Community. The funding will be used to accelerate integrated offerings, support physical clinics, and expand nutritional supplements. The company, co-founded in 2020 by Divya Kamerkar and Akanksha Vyas, aims to enable continuity of care at a national scale.
